summary: This directory serves as a central repository for path transformation utilities. It enables the project to consistently normalize file system paths and navigate between source files and their corresponding build outputs, ensuring reliable mapping across the development lifecycle.
responsibilities: Normalizing file system paths for consistent processing
Mapping source file paths to build output paths
Mapping build output paths back to original source paths
Identifying test files based on project conventions
relationships: Path normalization provides the foundation for consistent path mapping operations.
Mapping functions transform file path representations between source and build output contexts.
Test file identification logic relies on path normalization to ensure accurate pattern matching.
designDecisions: Centralization of path transformation logic for consistency
Encapsulation of file system mapping rules
